name: webexNotifyMigration
description: Secure, migration-aware Webex notifier. Reads WEBEX_ROOM_ID and WEBEX_ACCESS_TOKEN from the workflow's runtime input/state (NOT hardcoded — supply via a CWM secret/input or the 'webex' resource). Auto-summarizes the latest pre/post check result already in state (.postResult or .preResult): phase, PASS count / total, and the failed-check list (name@node). Callers may override the headline via .notifyPhase and .notifyStatus.

definition.name: webexNotifyMigration

stateDataFilter.output:
${ ( .postResult // .preResult // {} ) as $r | { WEBEX_ROOM_ID: .WEBEX_ROOM_ID, WEBEX_ACCESS_TOKEN: .WEBEX_ACCESS_TOKEN, _phase: ( .notifyPhase // $r.phase // "SRv6 Migration" ), _status: ( .notifyStatus // ( if ($r.allPass == true) then "PASS" elif ($r.allPass == false) then "FAILED" else "INFO" end ) ), _total: ( ( $r.results // [] ) | length ), _passed: ( ( $r.passed // [] ) | length ), _failedList: ( ( $r.failed // [] ) | map( .name + "@" + .node ) | join(", ") ) } | . + { webexBody: { markdown: ( "**SRv6 Migration — " + ._phase + "**  

Status: **" + ._status + "**  
Checks: " + ( ._passed | tostring ) + "/" + ( ._total | tostring ) + " PASS" + ( if ( ._failedList | length ) > 0 then "  
❌ FAILED: " + ._failedList else "" end ) + "  
" ), roomId: .WEBEX_ROOM_ID } } }
